findings.claim: GM 10-K（FY2025）Item 3 揭露：與 Ultium Cells 合資廠有關的 TSCA 進口違規已於 2023-11 與 EPA 以同意協議和解，截至 2025-12-31 GM 已累計估計 $18.2 million 民事罰款，EPA 發出 TSCA 5(e) 命令前罰款將持續增加，由 GM 與 Ultium Cells LLC 連帶負責。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR｜GM 10-K FY2025 Item 3. Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025, GM has incurred an estimated $18.2 million in civil penalties. These penalties, which will continue to grow until the EPA issues a TSCA 5(e) order, are assessed jointly and severally to GM and Ultium Cells LLC.

findings.claim: GM 2026 Q1 10-Q 提到 EPA 最終規則（生效 2026-04-20）廢除溫室氣體 endangerment finding 及相關車輛 GHG 標準；GM 預期部分美國排放標準因銷售組合可能不達標。
findings.excerpt: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) also finalized a rule (effective April 20, 2026) repealing its "endangerment finding" and removing greenhouse gas (GHG) regulations for light-, medium-, and heavy-duty on-highway vehicles on a retrospective and prospective basis.
